description: Before transacting with another agent, check whether it is FLOCORE-governed (a human-approval gate on its world-affecting actions, Ed25519 signed receipts) and, if it handed you a receipt, verify that receipt independently. Public, no token needed: this is the check a governed agent WANTS any counterparty to be able to run before dealing with it.

receipt_canonical.description: optional: the receipt's `canonical` field, if the counterparty handed you one to check

receipt_signature_ed25519.description: optional: the receipt's `signature_ed25519` field, required together with receipt_canonical to verify it

name: flocore_verify_counterparty
